events.title: Introducing DEADBOOT!!!!
events.summary: After working on this secret project for the past 6 months, we're super happy to finally announce our indie-game debut!! What is it? DEADBOOT is a roguelite retro FPS with an emphasis on great-feeling and adrenaline-inducing gameplay. See how far you can make it through this gauntlet of violent neon and gore, and hone your skills each run! Discovering new enemies, rooms and upgrades each time. Who are we? Thinking frog are two passionate game-devs with a collective 15 years of experience in AA/A
